name: 千棘盔
evolution: 海盔虫 → 刺盔虫 Lv.26 → 千棘盔 Lv.42 → 千棘海针
evolutionEn: Haikuichong → Cikuichong Lv.26 → Qianjikui Lv.42 → Qianjihaizhen
description: 平时它仍行动迟缓，但遇险时能短暂加速，脱离光照与威胁区域。受到轻微触碰时，棘刺会迅速聚合，并指向接触点，棘端的毒囊能造成刺痛与轻微麻木。
descriptionEn: Normally it still moves sluggishly, but when in danger it can briefly accelerate to escape lit and threatening areas. When lightly touched, its spines quickly converge and point toward the point of contact; the venom sacs at the spine tips can cause stinging pain and mild numbness.

skills.name: 甩水
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; recovers 1 energy for itself.

skills.name: 蓄水
skills.descriptionEn: The next skill used costs 6 less energy.

skills.name: 腐蚀酸液
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方获得2层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; the enemy gains 2 layers of Poison.

skills.name: 腐化
skills.description: 敌方每有1层中毒效果，敌方获得双攻-30%。
skills.descriptionEn: For each layer of Poison on the enemy, the enemy gets both attack stats -30%.

skills.name: 许愿星
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 疫病吐息
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 1 layer of Poison Mark.

skills.name: 泡沫幻影
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：自己脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%. Counters attacks: withdraws itself.

skills.name: 毒液渗透
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本技能能耗-1，敌方获得1层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. For each layer of Poison on the enemy, this skill's energy cost is -1; the enemy gains 1 layer of Poison.

skills.name: 毒雾
skills.description: 将敌方所有增益，转化成中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Converts all of the enemy's buffs into Poison.

skills.name: 涌泉
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能能耗每-1，威力+10。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. For every 1 reduction in this skill's energy cost, its power is +10.

skills.name: 盐水浴
skills.description: 自己获得全技能能耗-2，应对防御：改为技能能耗-3。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains -2 energy cost on all of its own skills. Countering a defense: -3 energy cost instead.

skills.name: 感染病
skills.description: 造成魔伤，若击败敌方则将中毒转化为中毒印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. If it defeats the enemy, converts Poison into Poison Mark.
